core_project_skills.name: handoff
core_project_skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

core_project_skills.name: understand
core_project_skills.description: Analyze a codebase to produce an interactive knowledge graph for understanding architecture, components, and relationships

core_project_skills.name: code-review
core_project_skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to \"review since X\".

core_project_skills.name: headroom
core_project_skills.description: Use when a Python or TypeScript app sends large tool outputs, logs, JSON, search results or long chat history to an LLM and the task is to cut input tokens, reduce token cost, fit a context window, or trim tool results without losing errors. Adds the headroom-ai compress() call; in-process, no API key, no model download.

core_project_skills.name: karpathy-guidelines
core_project_skills.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.

core_project_skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
core_project_skills.description: Design banners for social media, ads, website heroes, creative assets, and print. Multiple art direction options with optional generated or supplied visuals. Actions: design, create, generate banner. Platforms: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Google Display, website hero, print. Styles: minimalist, gradient, bold typography, photo-based, illustrated, geometric, retro, glassmorphism, 3D, neon, duotone, editorial, collage.

core_project_skills.name: impeccable
core_project_skills.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, simplify, harden, animate, or otherwise improve a frontend interface: websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, components, forms, settings, onboarding, empty states, and native iOS or Android screens. Handles UX review, hierarchy, layout, typography, color, motion, UX copy, accessibility, responsive behavior, edge cases, and capturing or documenting design systems (DESIGN.md, tokens). Also for making bland UI bolder, loud UI quieter, or ambitious visual effects. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

core_project_skills.name: antislop
core_project_skills.description: Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents. The core filter. Load always to stop generic AI slop.

core_project_skills.name: loop-me
core_project_skills.description: Grill me about specs for the workflows I want to build, within this workspace.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: antislop-code
lifecycle_project_skills.description: Code comment hygiene for AI coding agents: remove generic AI-slop comments, keep the valuable ones, never touch the code.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: antislop-copywriting
lifecycle_project_skills.description: Copy and text skill for antislop. Use when writing or editing prose: headlines, tone, CTAs, and anti-AI-writing patterns. Load with the core.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: antislop-human
lifecycle_project_skills.description: Human and accessibility skill for antislop. Contrast, keyboard, focus, states, and interaction affordances for real people. Includes the contrast checker.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: antislop-layoutmobile
lifecycle_project_skills.description: Mobile layout skill for antislop. Use for layouts that reflow across screen sizes, phone to desktop: grids, overflow, tap targets. Load with the core.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: antislop-ui
lifecycle_project_skills.description: UI and visual skill for antislop. Use when building or editing any interface: color, layout, components, motion, and page performance. Load with the core.

lifecycle_project_skills.name: ask-matt

lifecycle_project_skills.name: chief-of-staff

lifecycle_project_skills.name: claude-handoff
